result: Brainspotting can land on either side of this boundary: a resource-oriented or carefully titrated session can prepare you for deeper work, but going straight into highly charged developmental material is a different dose. With diffuse relational trauma, I sometimes think EMDR fits better after at least some inner-child reparenting, because once you can reach a Nurturer and a Protector, you have something to hold the material with. A stable person working on a single discrete event, though, may not need a long preliminary sequence at all.
